[b]Q4 Updates Planned[/b]

Galandrix is now live. Thank you to everyone who helped make it happen, along with the play testers and those who reported bugs. Look for these post release updates coming soon!

[list]
[*] [b]Steam Leaderboard (Time)[/b]
Tired of your friends mocking you that they beat insane mode? The next major update will include a steam leaderboard based on time. This will give an additional incentive to beat the game faster than your friends.

[*] [b]Improved Localization[/b]
Some of the translations into other languages don't translate properly. The next major update is going to include a better translation method and should make it easier for our worldwide players.

[*] [b]New Weapons[/b]
Look for some new weapons/items to assist in different builds. These are being tested currently and should be included in the next update.

[*] [b]New Enemies[/b]
Currently, there are some areas that can be improved with the AI on standard enemies. In addition, some new ones are planned. Look for more information on the next update.
[/list]

Again, thanks to everyone who has supported the game. You all rock!

Thanks!
DoomCraft
